checks: Version comparison uses numeric parts; downgrade and same version are rejected
Wrong tool, corruption, duplicate paths and traversal cannot reach disk writes
Permission expansion and identity or CSP changes require manual installation
Matching manifest in a different copied folder is rejected without changing existing files
Installed-folder proof is cleaned after successful validation
All originals are journaled before writing; manifest commits last; unrelated files remain
Mid-update write failure restores exact prior bytes and removes new files
Journal persistence failure leaves original source untouched
Interrupted transaction can restore from a saved journal
GitHub requests stay on the fixed repository, omit credentials and referrer, reject redirects and send no patient payload
Unavailable public source, 404, rate limits, timeout and oversized network bodies are explicit failures
Release index rejects another tool and mismatched version paths
